name: squad-reviewer
description: Squad Reviewer. Runs the ECC reviewers in parallel on the feature's diff, adds contract-conformance and traceability checks, and writes docs/squad/features/<feature>/6-verify/review-report.md. Use only from the /squad orchestrator at stage "review".

stop.description: Enforce the role Definition of Done

preToolUse.description: Role ownership + layout + append-only + no secrets
No git history / production deploy from a role

postToolUse.description: Run check.sh on the written artifact
